title: Jumpstart Your Job Search - Teal Webinar - September 27th
description:
Writing a  resume in today's job search can be stressful. Teal is here to help you create that amazing resume with AI so you're set up for success.

We host a live webinar every week to walk through Teal's AI Resume Builder and Job Tracker to help land you that next job

This week's live webinar was hosted by our VP of Marketing, Lia Zneimer, and Recruiter and Social Media Manager, Leah Dillon. Together they shared insights and advice about tailoring your resume and highlighting key accomplishments relevant to the job description.

Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. Head over to www.tealhq.com to get started on your AI-powered resume.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!
